question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 4% per month for 9 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the rate is given per month and time is in months, Total Effective Rate = 4% × 9 = 36%.

Simple Interest = 36% of ₹1200

⇒ SI = (36 ÷ 100) × 1200

⇒ SI = 432

**∴ The correct answer is ₹432.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per month

Time (T) = 9 months

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Principal
 ₹1200
 
 
• 
 
 
 Total Rate
 4% × 9 = 36%

 
• 

 
 Simple Interest
 ₹432

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (1200 × 4 × 9) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (1200 × 36) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × 36

⇒ SI = 432

**∴ The correct answer is ₹432.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

Total Amount = Principal + Simple Interest, which can be written as A = P[1 + (RT ÷ 100)].

Unit Consistency Rule

Always ensure that the unit of Time (T) matches the unit of the Rate of Interest (R). If the rate is given per month, the time must strictly be evaluated in months.

Compound Interest

Unlike Simple Interest, Compound Interest is calculated on the principal plus previously accumulated interest. Formula: CI = P(1 + R ÷ 100)T − P.
